vi.main: Nhom kiem tra da san sang
vi.firstAction: Tiep tuc theo cua so phat hanh

zh.sub: overall 为 PASS 且已通过数等于总数，当前可进入标准发布流程。
zh.firstAction: 先确认放行窗口与操作人，再执行发布。

en.sub: Overall is PASS and passedCount equals totalCount, ready for standard release flow.
en.firstAction: Confirm release window and operator first, then execute release.

vi.sub: Overall la PASS va passedCount bang totalCount, san sang cho quy trinh phat hanh chuan.
vi.firstAction: Xac nhan cua so phat hanh va nguoi thao tac truoc, sau do phat hanh.

zh.sub: 当前为全量未通过态，发布应保持阻断。
zh.firstAction: 先修复 checks 首个失败项，再重跑全套检查。

en.sub: Current state is full failure, release must remain blocked.
en.firstAction: Fix the first failed check in checks, then rerun full checks.

vi.sub: Trang thai hien tai la that bai toan bo, can tiep tuc chan phat hanh.
vi.firstAction: Sua muc loi dau tien trong checks, sau do chay lai toan bo kiem tra.

vi.main: Nhom kiem tra can ra soat
vi.firstAction: Ra soat cac muc chua dat truoc

zh.sub: 当前为部分通过态，不应解读为可直接发布。
zh.firstAction: 先定位未通过检查项并补测，通过后再进入放行确认。

en.sub: This is a partial pass state and must not be treated as directly releasable.
en.firstAction: Locate failed checks and retest first, then move to release confirmation.

vi.sub: Day la trang thai dat mot phan, khong duoc hieu la co the phat hanh ngay.
vi.firstAction: Xac dinh muc chua dat va kiem tra bo sung truoc, sau do moi xac nhan phat hanh.

partialPassReminder.zh: 部分通过仅表示风险收敛中，不代表可直接发布。
partialPassReminder.en: Partial pass means risk is being reduced, not that release is directly allowed.
partialPassReminder.vi: Dat mot phan chi cho thay rui ro dang duoc giam, khong co nghia la duoc phat hanh ngay.
